title: Web brand theme (Graph RAG)
description: Schema of a Graph RAG customer's reconfigurable web brand theme. It describes ONLY the fields actually used by the application: brand identity (name, eyebrow, logos), the colour palette (translated into CSS variables) and free-form CSS variable overrides. The front end applies these tokens at runtime — ThemeProvider (CSS variables + title + favicon), RootLayout (logo, name, eyebrow) and the brand theme admin screen. The document is validated on upload (POST /files/brand-theme). Absent a brand theme, the application keeps its default tokens (§9.1).

$schema.description: Reference to this schema (autocompletion / validation in editors).

client.description: Customer / organisation name. Displayed on the brand theme admin screen.

name.description: Displayed brand / product name. Becomes the document title (tab, EF-140) and the header name.

eyebrow.description: Small-caps kicker displayed in the header above the name.

primary.description: Primary logo (horizontal / full). Used as the header fallback when `brand.logo.mark` is absent.

mark.description: Reduced logo / monogram used in the header (takes priority over `primary`).

favicon.description: Site favicon (ICO/PNG/SVG), applied at runtime without redeployment (EF-133).

colors.description: Functional palette. Each key is translated by the application into a CSS variable (custom property). Absent keys keep the application's default token (§9.1).

onPrimary.description: Text / icon placed on a primary-coloured background (→ --on-primary).

cssVariables.description: CSS variable overrides applied as-is (key = variable name without the -- prefix, value = CSS value). Overlays and extends the `colors` palette; the most direct way to adjust any application token.

color.description: Colour in CSS format: hexadecimal (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa) or an rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() function.
